generate_difference_report: generate a difference report comparing two benchmark JSON runs with optional U-test and color output
filter_benchmark: filter benchmark JSON results by regex pattern and replace matching names with a replacement string
calculate_change: calculate the decimal change between an old and new benchmark value as a float
get_unique_benchmark_names: get all unique benchmark names from a JSON benchmark result while preserving order
calc_utest: calculate Mann-Whitney U test p-values for CPU and real time benchmark repetitions
